title: Louisiana and Montana place readings connect broadband delivery to observed use
summary: Two existing state portraits gain twelve full sections from retained November 21 evidence. Provider cohorts, grant programs, reporting periods and observations remain distinct.
evidence_note: Seventeen exact retained source-check records from three existing November 21 receipts support this November 22 authored and AI self-reviewed synthesis. Shared Louisiana program inspections are not duplicated as new fetches. The assigned Nextlink place context and separately labelled Starlink companion remain distinct; Montana ARPA announcements do not substitute for BEAD project-quarter returns. The initial four place readings, assessments and all evidence receipts remain unchanged.
publication_effect: No new counted identity, cycle gate, source inspection, place stage, project-stage promotion or operating outcome. Identity eligibility remains 100 projects and 70 places. Production acceptance, release, owner launch and actual stewardship remain open.
